I hold the whole song. Her whole name, the exact hour, the way the water took the ferry-boat's line taut when it left the eastern dock. My voice doesn't break,
Cal Renwick's Keening was, he noted, setting down his pen, unusually complete. Most men faltered on the hour; grief blurred time before it blurred anything else
